name: Obscurity State
detailed_description:
Feel yourself in the role of one of the looters who found themselves in an abandoned town in search of a Mysterious Artifact. 

Dangerous monsters that are now the only inhabitants of the city are not the worst thing that awaits you, the most insidious enemies are other players. Trust becomes a luxury because everyone is for themselves and only a coincidence decides whether you will be allies or enemies with other players. Compete for the Mysterious Artifact in online sessions for up to 8 players and be vigilant, because only one will win.

And hurry up, you only have until morning to leave the city.

Use a lighter and a fuel canister to light your way and burn everything and everyone that stands between you and your goal, because sometimes the only way to survive is to leave behind only ashes.

Every word or sound you make can give you away. In this city, even the walls have ears, and monsters and other players will be waiting for you to make a mistake. Keep this in mind when choosing your tactics.

The toolkit of sound devices that you can buy in the game store can be very useful in the fight against all enemies.

Each player starts the game alone, you don't know where you are, you don't know who you will meet on your way.

In each game session, the city changes its landscape, which guarantees the uniqueness of each passage and makes you rely solely on your intuition when any next turning point could be the last.

Your hero's characteristics are influenced by a lot of factors: items that temporarily improve or worsen abilities, enemies that can affect your character's state.

But the most important thing is that you never know what condition you will find yourself in the city next time. Your character may get sick on the way, have a fight with someone the day before, be just tired, or have a hangover. All of this will affect your playthrough of each game session.

short_description: "Obscurity State" is a cooperative horror game with rogue-lite elements, where you and your friends (up to 8 players) play as scavengers exploring an abandoned city in search of a mysterious artifact. Form alliances or betray other players, but remember, in the end, you're on your own.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit 64bit OS required
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 1080p: Geforce GTX 1650, Radeon RX 5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, Keyboard, Microphone for team communication

  • DirectX: Version 11
